evidence: G08 real validate endpoint returned HTTP 500 / UnexpectedRollbackException for a stale checklist version.
cause: The nested MANDATORY checklist validator marked the shared session transaction rollback-only before OrderService converted the expected ApiException into field errors.
fix: noRollbackFor ApiException on read-only selection preparation only; capture still rolls back normally.
verification: G08, G09, G10 real API replay passed; 31 related Java tests passed.

evidence: B07 explained factory checklists after the customer selected construction monitoring.
cause: The structured writer saw all services' checklists together, and repeated another service's catalog context.
fix: Scope checklist context to the selected service; leave other service choices available when explicitly choosing/changing service.
verification: B07 real model replay passed; final regression pending.

evidence: C02 duplicated one requested video across two items; C05 selected the entire optional package; C09 retained photos after an explicit video-only request.
cause: Package defaults were mistaken for per-item customer totals and optional package items were selected unnecessarily.
fix: Validate aggregate video counts, honor explicit no-image/no-video instructions, omit empty optional items, and constrain a new narrow single-media suggestion without selecting the full optional package.
verification: C02, C05, C09 real model replays passed; final regression pending.

evidence: D01-D15 exposed acknowledgments without saved contact/site/purpose values; follow-up replies were generic and sometimes proposed an unrelated service.
cause: Optional extraction fields, competing old assistant text, and English enum codes allowed missing or semantically wrong proposals.
fix: Require extraction for explicitly supplied fields, constrain literal customer values and form labels, scope changes to the current intent, make recall read-only, and ground recall in the customer-confirmed values.
verification: Final real-model regression pending; no template answer or mock model added.

evidence: E09 switching back to factory inspection failed because its service name was interpreted as an instruction to choose construction checklists.
cause: The words 'chọn' and 'kiểm tra' in a service name triggered checklist selection against the previous service.
fix: Separate service selection from checklist selection and scope simultaneous media proposals to the newly selected service.
